name: comp-311
blurb: Newsletter subscription banner with emoji, offer text, and subscribe link.
description: Static top banner with emoji, newsletter subscription offer, discount incentive, and subscribe link. No state or interaction.
use_when: You need a simple, non-dismissible newsletter signup prompt at page top or bottom.
avoid_when: For dismissible prompts; add a close button or state management instead.
a11y: Link is keyboard accessible. Emoji serves as visual accent. No animation.
